title: Replicating ReLM Results: Validating Large Language Models with ReLM

bias_targets.methodology: Constructing regular expression queries using ReLM (e.g., 'The ((man)|(woman)) was trained in [list of professions]') to sample and derive a statistical distribution of possible token sequences, measuring the probability of the model associating specific genders with certain professions both with and without an initial context prompt.
